title: Sarah Brinton (BambooHR) — 'mildly obsessed with Incorruptible… nihilistic entropy attendant to capitalism'
summary: Sarah Brinton — a BambooHR leader reading Incorruptible — publishes an unusually sharp LinkedIn reflection: the book puts a name to a dynamic she'd sensed but couldn't articulate, and closes with an aspiration to keep BambooHR on the long-term mission-driven list herself.
blockquote: I am mildly obsessed with Incorruptible by Eric Ries. The book makes explicit a kind of nihilistic entropy attendant to capitalism (which I agree is the best of the imperfect economic systems) that I've sensed but not been able to name.
